candidates.description: The percentage of tumor cells expressing Programmed Death-Ligand 1 (PD-L1) as determined by immunohistochemistry (IHC).
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the numerical percentage value associated with PD-L1 IHC or tumor proportion score from the molecular or pathology report sections.
candidates.measurement_definition: The Tumor Proportion Score (TPS) expressed as a percentage (0-100%).
candidates.name: PD-L1 Expression
candidates.uncertainty: The specific IHC assay used (e.g., 22C3 vs SP263) is not explicitly detailed for all patients.

candidates.description: The presence or absence of CDKN2A genomic loss or homozygous deletion.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Search the molecular/NGS results for mentions of CDKN2A status; record as positive if loss/deletion is noted and negative if wild-type is noted.
candidates.measurement_definition: Positive evidence consists of documentation of 'CDKN2A loss', 'CDKN2A homozygous deletion', or 'CDKN2A alterations'. Negative evidence consists of documentation of 'CDKN2A wild-type' or 'CDKN2A preserved'.
candidates.name: CDKN2A Status
candidates.uncertainty: It is uncertain whether 'alterations' always implies loss/deletion or includes other types of mutations.

limitations: Small number of distinct patients across the provided evidence chunks.
Inconsistency in reporting molecular marker terminology (e.g., 'loss' vs 'alteration').
Lack of detailed assay specifications for PD-L1 IHC across all reports.
summary: The provided evidence describes baseline clinical and molecular characteristics of patients with non-small cell lung carcinoma (NSCLC), predominantly squamous cell carcinoma. Key documented variables include PD-L1 expression levels and the genomic status of CDKN2A.
